preconditions.description: The number of steps on the stairs is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The string s has a length equal to the number of steps n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'UD' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is either 'U' or 'D', representing the initial direction of the pointer above each step.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of n numbers, one for each step.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(x == -1 or x >= 0 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is either -1 (indicating Olga never goes beyond the stairs) or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or output[i] >= i for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If Olga never goes beyond the stairs from step i, the output for step i is -1. Otherwise, the output for step i is at least i, indicating the duration of Olga's dream.
